## Description

Two-layer nested HMM that classifies macro market regimes (Bull/Bear) at the top level and micro regimes (High/Low Volatility) at the sub-level.

## Where it may fit

Shifting market environments, macro economic turning points, automated risk-on/risk-off portfolio leverage scaling.

## Vehicles

Macro hedge funds, tactical asset allocation funds, retail API accounts trading leveraged ETFs (TQQQ/SQQQ).

## Required data

Daily/hourly OHLCV bars, VIX index, interest rate spreads, macroeconomic indicators.

## Caveats

Latent state transitions can lag abrupt shock events; transition probability matrices must be re-calibrated regularly to avoid stale regime assignments.
